raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for your inquiry. We understand that your manufacturing team is currently exploring options, and we appreciate your interest in Cedar Systems. To ensure we align with your needs, we would like to clarify what specific requirements or goals you are looking to address with our workflow coordination and account reporting solutions.

Once we have a better understanding of your needs, we can schedule a discovery meeting to discuss integration requirements and how Cedar Systems can support your operations.

Please let us know a convenient time to connect and provide further details.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What specific goals or requirements are you looking to address with workflow coordination and account reporting?
Is there a particular department or team that will be leading this initiative?
